name: magicinterview
description: Get live AI suggestions for what to say in job interviews, sales calls, and meetings, tailored to your CV, job description, client brief, and notes.

interface.shortDescription: Know what to say next, live.
interface.longDescription: Know what to say next, even when the question catches you off guard. MagicInterview listens to your interview or meeting and shows suggested responses as the conversation happens. Add your CV and the job description for a job interview, or bring your client brief and notes to a sales call. Read a suggestion, adapt it, and keep the conversation moving. Use it on your computer or keep it open on your phone beside your call. Android also has a native app. This plugin lets your AI assistant organize projects, documents, and conversations, investigate session problems, and open the right meeting in MagicInterview.
defaultPrompt: I have a job interview. Use my CV and the job description to set up live help, then open that MagicInterview conversation.
I have a meeting with a potential client. Use our brief and past notes to set up live suggestions for the call.
Set up today's meetings in MagicInterview, starting with the next unfinished one, and give me links I can open on my phone.
Inspect the latest MagicInterview debug logs and help diagnose a problem with my conversation.
